\[
I_{\text{out}}(x', y') = I(x' + x_0,\; y' + y_0),\qquad 0 \le x' < w,\quad 0 \le y' < h
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(x_0, y_0\): The left and top edges of the rectangle
- \(w, h\): The width and height of the rectangle

The output pixel at x', y' is the input pixel x_0 columns further right and y_0 rows further down. Only the w x h pixels of the rectangle are kept. The selection is cropped the same way.
